title: Sydney Harbour on foot
content:
Circular Quay to the Opera House, round the Royal Botanic Garden to Mrs Macquarie's Point, back through the city to The Rocks and over the Harbour Bridge's footway to Milsons Point.

Demo day: the walk is a simulated route along real streets. Photographs from Wikimedia Commons, credited in each caption.
